title: 1811 Prairie's scrolled basement grilles and stepped porch arcade
items: The two basement windows under 1811 Prairie's bay now carry the scrolled iron grilles the c. 1888 photograph shows: a rosette, eight spokes and a ring, with a curled scroll in each corner, inside a border of short bars. The windows reach lower, to where the photograph puts their foot.
The small arcade round the porch's rounded corner now steps down about 10 cm with each of its three columns, as both the 1888 plate and the photograph draw it.
